title: Splat Playground
description: Run, jump, and orbit four rigged characters across six streamed Gaussian-splat worlds with live world and character switching, collision, and adaptive lighting.

prompt.objective: Build a third-person character playground across streamed Gaussian-splat worlds.
experience: Move, run, jump, orbit, and tune grounding and lighting.
Hot-swap worlds and characters with collision and contact shadows.
prompt.visualDirection: Full-bleed worlds, translucent controls, grounded characters, and adaptive light.
